h1: AI UGC Ads for Shoe Brands, On Foot and in Motion

card: On-foot steps, unboxings, fit checks, and listing photos from one shoe photo.

faq.q: Can one side photo cover both a listing image and a walking clip?
faq.a: Yes. A clear side view can guide a white-background photo and a short on-foot scene. Keep the toe, heel, ankle opening, and sole edge visible so the pair stays recognizable.

faq.q: Can a side shot produce a sole or heel view?
faq.a: No. Start from a separate photo of the sole or the heel. A side photo cannot show a sole pattern that was never in the file.

faq.q: Can I make an Amazon main image this way?
faq.a: Yes. For a main image, show the shoe alone on pure white. It should fill most of the frame. Leave out extra objects and any text on the picture. Put size and width notes in the gallery or the listing text.

faq.q: Can I show a sneaker logo I do not own?
faq.a: No. If you ask for a logo or a brand mark you do not own, the request can be refused. Resellers of branded pairs should use their own straight product photos for those listings.
Start with one full side view, then a top view and a sole or heel shot. Those three cover the shape and the sole pattern a shopper checks.

faq.q: How do I keep an unbranded pair from looking branded?
faq.a: Start from a plain pair and check the result for stripes, sole shapes, or stitching that resemble a known logo. Keep marks you do not own out of the source photo and the finished scene.

faq.q: Can the clips run as paid shoe ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads come back without a watermark, so a paid ad is fine. You can publish the clip to TikTok or Meta, or download it and post it yourself.

faq.q: How long can a shoe clip be, and what does it cost?
faq.a: Choose 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Frames include 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, and 3:4. Those lengths spend 24, 40, 60, and 120 credits. If the clip fails, the credits return. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300 credits, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I start from a product link and make more than one version?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page, or send the link from your shop software through the API. Ask for one step in one version and a white-background side view in the other.
